title: Coiled Serpent Spell Shop
description: A hooded figure in a dark blue cloak stands on a cobblestone street reading a scroll in front of an old wooden magic shop. The storefront is heavily decorated with two massive coiled blue-black serpents wrapped around the door and sign, hanging herbs, glowing lanterns, and glass potion jars.
prompt: A mysterious hooded figure in a dark cloak stands before an ancient wooden storefront at night on a cobblestone alley. The shop sign reads 'COILED SERPENT SPELLS & BINDINGS'. Two enormous, highly detailed blue-black serpents with glowing eyes are coiled around the doorway and sign. Hanging dried herbs, glowing lanterns, and shelves of potion jars decorate the facade. Dark fantasy atmosphere with moody lighting.
